race.comment: The well-related LIFE OF TREE (9) (full to G3 winner The Amazonian) has been thereabouts at the past couple of efforts and looks to be building up to another victory. Strikes a winnable contest here and should be right there when the whips are cracking. KNOWITALL FRANK (2) is one from one over this track and trip and maps ideally for this contest from gate four. Definite top-three prospects. LOVE TO BE PROUD (15) got the job done here three back before being right in the mix at the last couple of outings. Don't dismiss lightly. ANYWAY YOU WANT IT (6) strips fitter second-up from the break and may earn some minor money. EZEIZA (10) best of the rest from the inside marble.
